query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So long, Stephen — but not goodbye forever!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix bugs — they *become* the legend that future engineers whisper about in dark server rooms. 🖥️✨

Stephen, you didn't just write great code — you wrote your name into the hearts of this team (and probably into a few memes too 😄). Whether it was debugging the impossible, cracking us up with the perfect meme at the perfect moment, or just being the kind of colleague who made Mondays feel less like Mondays — you were one of a kind.

As you close this chapter and open an exciting new one, remember:
- 🚀 **Great engineers build things that last** — and so do great friendships.
- 😂 **The internet will never run out of memes** — so we expect updates.
- 💡 **The best is always yet to come** — and for you, that bar is *already* sky-high.

Go out there and keep being the amazing human and brilliant engineer that you are. The team will never be the same without you — but we'll carry forward the laughter, the late-night debugging sessions, and yes, the memes. 🙌

**You'll be missed more than Stack Overflow on a no-internet day.** 💙

*Wishing you all the best on your next adventure, Stephen!* 🎊

---

Feel free to tweak names, add personal details, or customize it further! 😊
